children: Alphabet plans $195–$205 billion in 2026 capital spending, mainly on AI infrastructure, with investment set to rise further in 2027. Q3 free cash flow turned negative amid higher spending.
Alphabet Class C (GOOGL) said Google Search and other revenue rose 12% in Q3, down from 17% in Q2. Greater AI Mode use contributed to slower growth, as queries generated less revenue.
Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOGL) reported negative free cash flow of US$9.1 billion in the third quarter.
Alphabet (GOOGL) is seeking to sell its Tensor Processing Units for use in customers’ data centers. Meta has reportedly discussed spending billions of dollars on Google chips in 2027.
Trump threatened a “tremendous tax” on U.S. tech firms building data centers abroad and urged Alphabet (GOOGL) to invest in U.S. facilities. He gave no details on the proposed tax.
Alphabet (GOOGL) shares rose 3% Friday morning after it raised C$6 billion in Canadian bonds across four maturities. Proceeds are for general corporate needs and may repay debt.
Alphabet is building TPU Command Center software to simplify chip operations. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said nearly 100 customers use its TPUs, including Anthropic and Apple.
Alphabet’s Google Quantum AI tested Willow in GHZ games with up to 71 qubits, retaining an edge over classical limits as performance fell with scale. A 105-qubit test yielded about 60% accuracy.
